verification.fullExtension: Existing Chrome clipboard, storage, directory I/O, reload and retained UI gates remain mandatory before packaging.
verification.projectTrash: Separate real-extension gate covers deletion, restore, expiry and inbox.
verification.ownerWindows: Not tested on the owner's computer. Separate Windows app is unchanged.
verification.webStage: Experimental independent Chrome popup per logical workspace tab, positioned at the workspace frame with the native Chrome titlebar reserved inside the frame. Switching retains document state; inactive windows remain open when the parent tab changes; only switching logical OSMINOG site tabs minimizes the unselected popup. Geometry changes do not steal focus. Native new-window POST/auth pages remain separate and untouched. No always-on-top or WebContents embedding is claimed; Chrome/OS may still place the popup behind the parent when another surface is focused.
verification.mediaTransfer: Image import from an explicitly authorized editable page copy is tested; live provider media is not claimed.
